actions: Record new JS/CSS/index and probe hashes, loaded URLs, source/IR/document revision/frontier/camera/viewport/DPR and which cards intersect visible surface. Fix same page preset and target coordinates across compared runs.

Record real browser version/build, engine/surface (IAB or named browser), headless/embedded status if observable, display/refresh/GPU/CPU/power environment and actual resolved-font evidence. Leave unknowns explicit; CSS font-family and fonts.status loaded do not bind glyph font bytes.
Record start/end UTC plus performance.timeOrigin and browser monotonic timestamps. New renderer does not inherit old au3 performance or control result.
nextMeasurementControls.decision: Claims limited to actually frozen/observed hardware and fonts; no invented lock.

actions: Keep measured surface visibly foreground and unobstructed, with no tab switching/minimize/occluding panels during timed window. Record visible top document and iframe, focus, lifecycle freeze/resume/pagehide/pageshow and measurement-window reasons; record browser/surface visibility independently when tools support it.

For existing iframe harness, outer viewport must accommodate controls144px plus iframe720px (at least864px height) or move measurement controls outside measured visible rectangle in a separately versioned helper. Observe real iframe/frame/target intersection with top-level viewport; inner viewport intersection alone does not prove onscreen presence.

After arm, return focus to intended Studio surface, allow a short stable warmup and bracket native pointerdown/up. Record focus transitions; parent hasFocus true alone does not prove app/window presentation.
Read receipts, screenshots, selectors or large DOM only outside continuous timed input window. Preserve all tool-call times and native input timing; isTrusted is not OS hardware/human proof.
nextMeasurementControls.decision: Any hidden/frozen/occluded or unexplained view/focus transition marks the affected window as confounded, retained rather than discarded silently.

actions: Run existing /__m4/control top-level20second idle plus ordinary click trials on the same browser surface and fixed environment; repeat and retain raw start/end environment, rAF, EventTiming, callbacks and input records. Source existence does not imply current executed result.
Take at least three control windows and three matched product windows; alternate order to expose warmup/drift. Freeze reset state and clock/duration before input.

If empty control shows comparable1s/paired cadence or high click durations, record evidence for environment/surface scheduling contamination. Do not turn product result into pass, subtract control latency, or assert named background policy from correlation.
nextMeasurementControls.decision: A continuously visible responsive control is a prerequisite for treating product slow cadence as workload evidence; repeated confounded controls require fixing measurement conditions first.

actions: In the existing harness compare raf-only vs full in separate matched20s sessions for initial4-node and expanded304-rendered frontiers, same camera and visible target. Raf-only cannot arm trials in current helper and gives callback cadence only; document any manual input separately.
For full mode bracket one operation per session, with same native path/duration/repeat count and selected object; avoid including human/tool waits in operation duration or choosing fastest samples.

If top-level Studio can be instrumented through an independently versioned DOM-only helper, compare top-level vs iframe. Current harness cannot provide top-level Studio measurement by itself. Keep helper/source build separate and compare perturbation.

Record observer direct self-cost and total performance trace/heap/GC/layout evidence when available. Full SVG/metadata copies and getComputedStyle/getBoundingClientRect can perturb layout/memory even when timed callback bodies are small.

Existing Studio telemetry/renderer/system/browser observer-delivery work is not isolated by current self-cost. Do not disable production work invisibly; disclose any experimental change as distinct version/environment.
nextMeasurementControls.decision: Full/raf-only comparison can bound observable perturbation; it cannot make rAF into presentedFPS or isolate GC without further evidence.

nextMeasurementControls.condition: Separate actual presentation and latency measurement
actions: Use an available browser compositor/presentation trace or externally timestamped visible display/video capture with known frame rate and display conditions to bind native input, commit and first actually presented response. State method resolution and capture overhead.

Synchronize input timestamps/monotonic trace clock and define frames during continuous gesture, all attempted inputs and trial duration before measuring. Preserve missing/ambiguous/coalesced/dropped/error denominators and no-input trials.

Use EventTiming only for its supported discrete inputs with reported start/processing/end/duration and unique interaction IDs. Report matched-subset p95 separately from all-pageINP. Pointermove/wheel continuous paint needs separate evidence.
Keep full duration distributions and before/during/after segments. Native EventTiming remainder is arithmetic until reported duration, not an independently identified paint or GPU cost.
If installed tools cannot access presentation evidence, retain callback/DOM diagnostic scope and do not certify presentedFPS or input-to-paint.
nextMeasurementControls.decision: Only an independently tied presented response supports presentation performance claims. Route shortening alone has no latency/FPS conclusion.
